column1: # Mists addon test manifest. Read by scripts/test-classic-addons.sh.
# Tab-separated; lines starting with # are comments; blank lines ignored.
#   name     Slug used as Interface/AddOns/<name> and vendor/addons/<name>
#   profile  Cargo client-* feature without the prefix (currently mists)
#   url      Git repo URL, or local:<absolute-path> for installed addons
#   ref      Branch / tag / SHA to pin (avoid HEAD — pin everything).
#   subpath  Path inside the source where the addon's TOC lives.
#            "." means root. Use multiple lines per repo if the addon ships
